_scaffold: About Us (/about/), Free Tools (/resources/free-tools/), Free Downloads (/resources/free-downloads/), Blog (/resources/blog/) and Contact Us (/contact/) are Phase 8 pages, all built. Free Tools/Free Downloads/Blog live inside the "Resources" mega menu; About Us and Contact Us are their own top-level nav items (2026-09-18).
_structure: Desktop header (restructured 2026-09-18, decluttered from a split/centered-logo layout to a single row): logo, then one inline nav list, then Book a Call + the primary CTA button pinned to the right. Items with `megaMenu: true` render the two-pane flyout (tool/page list + promo panel); items with a plain `children` array render the simple link-list dropdown. Tablet/mobile (<1080px) is unchanged: a centered logo, the fixed bottom tab bar (`tabBar`) and the right-side icon-tile "More" drawer (`more`) carry navigation instead.
